page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.3xlarge is a local SSD-equipped instance type within the ecs.i1 server family. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture, it features 12 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The server configuration includes 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

A central characteristic of this instance is its bundled 670 GB local SSD storage, which delivers direct disk access for applications requiring low-latency operations without relying exclusively on networked block volumes. For networking, the instance offers a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured elastic IPs or private virtual network setups for external communication. There are no discrete GPU accelerators attached.

The instance integrates older Broadwell-generation Intel Xeon hardware alongside dedicated resource allocations and fixed local solid-state storage. While the baseline 2 Gbps network throughput poses limits on cross-node data transfer rates compared to newer generations, the local SSD array provides predictable storage access suitable for mid-sized relational databases, NoSQL datastores, search indexes, and caching layers requiring local read and write buffers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.3xlarge is an x86_64 storage-oriented virtual instance from the Local SSDs family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 12 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, paired with 48.0 GB of RAM to maintain a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. A defining feature of the server is its integrated 670 GB local SSD, intended for applications that demand localized, direct-attached disk access without network storage latency. The instance provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps and operates without attached GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Due to its combination of dedicated compute, balanced memory, and built-in solid-state drive capacity, the ecs.i1.3xlarge fits mid-tier database management systems, localized caching tiers, transactional workloads, and search engine nodes requiring reliable I/O performance on local disk storage.
